meta.title: Apply one RFP template to all line items via bulk Select Template

plan.title: Bulk apply RFP template to all line items

steps.note: Configure the event with a Technical Stage.
Review and configure the Technical Stage.
Apply the required RFP stage template before adding line items.
Create several line items for the bulk template operation.

args.goal: On the Technical Stage, open the bulk Select Template action, choose one RFP template, apply it to all line items, and stop on the screen showing that the same selected template is applied to every line item

steps.note: Perform and verify the bulk Select Template operation, including the per-line-item result.
Confirm the bulk application completed without an application error.
